question: Do the two frozen width-64 B2-v3 checkpoints improve a group-disjoint train-only panel that was never used in B2 optimization?
hypothesis: The frame-conditioned width-64 correction learned a medium/source-conditioned propagation rule rather than a record lookup, so at least half of its development-set gain will transfer to unseen train records for both seeds.
mechanism: No parameters are updated. Each frozen checkpoint receives only static medium/source features, the first eight true frames, and the solve-free warp render. Transfer is measured on future train-truth frames 8 through 63.
one_variable: record identity and medium group are changed from the 90-record development fit panel to a new 30-record train-only panel; checkpoint, IC count, anchor, model, metric, and rollout horizon are fixed

gate.primary_metric: per-record relative L2 over future frames 8 through 63, averaged over all 30 records
gate.family_gate: candidate family mean must be strictly below the same-panel warp-anchor family mean for uniform, layered, and marmousi
gate.seed_gate: aggregate, family, and nonworse gates must pass independently for both seed 372 and seed 733 checkpoints
gate.failure_signal: reject cross-record generalization if either seed misses any subgate; do not start tail-aware or spectral-loss long training from these checkpoints

data.future_truth_access: train truth is used only to freeze onset-aligned windows and to score serialized predictions; model.forward_anchored receives target[:, :8] only

amendments.reason: The first screen launch exited at module import before reading the manifest or creating cache/output artifacts because direct script execution did not place the repository root on sys.path.

rollback: additive diagnostic only; preserve all V3 and protected checkpoint families; on failure retain terminal/log and do not reuse a partial cache
claim_scope: A pass supports only train-record cross-group transfer of frozen B2-v3 checkpoints and authorizes a later train-only fit/confirmation experiment. It does not promote B2, does not count as complete validation, and does not establish test_id or runtime target compliance.
